headline: COP31 extends negotiations amid dispute over fossil fuels
summary: The UK and the European Union closed agreements on food trade and youth mobility to restore ties. No progress was reported on university tuition fees.
why: UK-EU trade arrangements affect tariffs and regulatory alignment for food exporters and cross-border businesses after Brexit.
original_headline: La COP31 prolonga sus negociaciones en plena pugna sobre los combustibles fósiles
